international.title: NFL’s Jaylen Harrell reportedly assaulted driver before crash that left player seriously injured
international.summary: Incident occurred in Tampa on Friday morning Crash leaves linebacker with serious injuries Tampa police are investigating whether Tennessee Titans linebacker Jaylen Harrell assaulted a rideshare driver before a crash that left the NFL player in hospital. The Tampa ⁠Police Department, in ⁠a preliminary report, said Harrell was in the back seat of the car around 8.45am on Friday in the backseat when “he reportedly assaulted the driver while ⁠the vehicle was in motion.” The driver then swerved, struck another car and collided ⁠with a utility pole, per the police report.
